name: Girl A
source:
Real name: [spoiler]一之瀬 玲菜 Ichinose Reina[/spoiler]
Age: unknown
Likes: chatting, Judgement 7
Skills: cooking, cleaning and housework in general
Role: unknown

A mysterious girl whom Judgement 7 met in the streets of Asakusa during New World experience. She does not even remember her own name, so she was given the name "Girl A" when she tagged along with Judgement 7. She seems to be pursued by unidentified people in black suits and to be deeply involved with the New World.

[Translated from [url=http://oreowa.jp/character/girl-a.html]the official site[/url]]
